integrity: The scientific claim is the new minimax/stability inequality, its strict equality classification and its unique limiting extremal shape; the fixed-triangle exact perimeter formula is prior work.
scientific_limitations: The universal inequality and sharp constant hold only for Euclidean triangular containers and 0<area fraction<1.
The coefficient is globally sharp only in a degenerate limiting shape; it is not attained by a non-equilateral nondegenerate triangle.
The equilateral equality case invokes the existing fixed-container extremal theorem from arXiv:2610.36220v1.
No independent mathematical audit or definitive historical-priority certification has been performed.
title: Sharp minimax stability for reverse perimeter profiles of triangular containers
